description.value:
Water Dragon Bullet. You shape a nearby body of water (or your own ambient chakra-water) into a serpentine dragon that crashes along a 60-foot line, 5 feet wide. Creatures in the line take 7d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save and are pushed 10 feet away from you on a failure (knocked prone on critical failure).

If you have no source water within 30 feet (the dragon needs at least a barrel's worth), the damage drops by 2d8.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d8.
